purpose: Candidate distribution-family policy for historical uncertainty modeling. These are model classes to test during calibration, not assumed truths.

pass_attempts.notes: Volume stat; test heavy-tail behavior and role-regime splits.

pass_yards.notes: Continuous-ish aggregate with game-script and efficiency tails.

pass_tds.notes: Discrete count; over-dispersion must be tested.

rush_attempts.notes: Count-like volume with role and game-script regime dependence.

rush_yards.notes: Can include negative values; do not force plain lognormal.

receptions.notes: Prefer conditional modeling on targets when data supports it.

receiving_yards.notes: Heavy tails and role changes are common.

selection_rule: Choose distribution family by holdout calibration and predictive scoring, not visual fit alone. Prefer simpler families when performance is materially equivalent.
